evidence.quote: Starting next month, we will be purchasing $15 billion of securities per month, down $10 billion per month from our current rate.
it likely will be appropriate to maintain the current target range for the federal funds rate for a considerable time after the asset purchase program ends
So there is significant underutilization of labor resources.
Moreover, inflation has firmed some since earlier in the year, and the Committee believes that the likelihood of inflation running persistently below 2 percent has diminished.
then increases in the federal funds rate are likely to occur sooner and to be more rapid than currently envisaged.
the Committee intends to reduce securities holdings in a gradual and predictable manner, primarily by ceasing to reinvest repayments of principal on securities held in the System Open Market Account.

parsed.rationale: Continued tapering, planned end of purchases, and normalization principles lean hawkish, while the reaffirmed 'considerable time' guidance, below-normal rates for some time, and emphasis on labor slack lean dovish. Net signal is roughly balanced with a slight dovish tilt.
